sqlite3 nsys_reports/graph_node.sqlite <<'SQL'
.headers on
.mode column

SELECT sql
FROM sqlite_master
WHERE type='table'
  AND name='CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME';

SELECT sql
FROM sqlite_master
WHERE type='table'
  AND name='CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL';

SELECT sql
FROM sqlite_master
WHERE type='table'
  AND name LIKE '%STRING%';
SQL

    eventClass                  INTEGER   NOT NULL,       ...

sqlite3 nsys_reports/graph_node.sqlite <<'SQL'
.headers on
.mode column

SELECT
    start,
    end,
    graphNodeId,
    gridId
FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL
WHERE graphNodeId IS NOT NULL
  AND start >= 6737498621
ORDER BY start
LIMIT 100;
SQL
